verses.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
"Tell the people of Israel: When a man has a flow of fluid from his body, that flow makes him unclean.
He is unclean whether the fluid keeps flowing or whether it stops. That is what makes him unclean.
Any bed he lies on is unclean, and anything he sits on is unclean.
Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Anyone who sits on something the unclean man sat on must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Anyone who touches the man's body must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
If the man with the flow spits on someone who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Any saddle the man rides on is unclean.
Anyone who touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening. Anyone who carries those things must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Anyone the man touches without rinsing his hands in water must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
A clay pot the man touches must be broken, and any wooden bowl must be rinsed with water.
When the man is healed of his flow, he must count seven days for his cleansing. He must wash his clothes and bathe his body in fresh running water, and then he will be clean.
On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons, come to the door of the Tent of Meeting in front of the LORD, and give them to the priest.
The priest will offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make him right with God in front of the LORD for his flow.
When a man has a release of seed, he must bathe his whole body in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Any clothing or leather that has seed on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean until evening.
When a man and a woman have sexual relations and there is a release of seed, they must both bathe in water, and they will be unclean until evening.
When a woman has her monthly flow of blood, she will be unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
Anything she lies on during her monthly flow is unclean, and anything she sits on is unclean.
Anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Anyone who touches anything she sits on must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
Whether it is her bed or something she sits on, anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.
If a man sleeps with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days, and any bed he lies on will be unclean.
If a woman has a flow of blood for many days outside her monthly time, or if the flow continues past her monthly time, she is unclean all the days of that flow, just as during her monthly period.
Any bed she lies on during her flow is unclean, like her bed during her monthly period. Anything she sits on is unclean, like during her monthly period.
Anyone who touches these things is unclean. He must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he will be unclean until evening.
When she is healed of her flow, she must count seven days, and after that she will be clean.
On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
The priest will offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make her right with God in front of the LORD for the uncleanness of her flow.
You must keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so they will not die by making my Holy Tent unclean, the Tent that is among them."
This is the teaching about a man with a flow, and about a man who becomes unclean from a release of seed,
and about a woman during her monthly period, and about a man or woman with a flow, and about a man who sleeps with a woman who is unclean.
